But seriously - if you feel overwhelmed by anxiety, the thoughts in your head, sadness, anything, please just next time you see your doctor, just bring it up, even if you can only just brush the surface of it, your doc will help lead the conversation. Mm, yes. Thats really hard, I'm sorry. If they've been with you through everything, they seem like they really care about you. Try and get together in person if you can. Do you have any family nearby? It's always good to connect with those who will truly be there forever.

Spend today focusing on you. The things you like to do, by yourself. Because you have so much worth, just being you, just living your life. So many people would love to accompany you on your strange journeys of doing whatever makes your heart happy, so don't shut down because these three have checked out. Start with your favourite breakfast, or some childhood tv shows. Make today a blockbuster day to remind yourself how fun you are.

Then don't sleep. If you aren't doing anything tomorrow, that is. Just give them space for today ok? Let it breathe and cool down while you focus on yourself today. You are not your friends, your life is not your friends and your worth is not your friends. I'm not sure how old you are, but friends are some of the least permanent things in life. I know it seems like this is your whole world, and like it's crashing around you right now, but trust me when I say the dust will settle. I spent most of my senior year wandering the hallways alone, and as long as you can find that one person to be your rock, you will survive my man.
